verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the story almost word for word: "Run AI inference globally with one API call… no GPUs to manage, no capacity planning" (cloudflare-docs-3). Workers AI is described as serverless model execution with no scaling or unused infrastructure to worry about (cloudflare-docs-24), and it offers a catalog of 50+ open-source models (cloudflare-docs-35). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that inference works as claimed, and a concrete documented example of the single inference call (binding or REST snippet) in the evidence.
